byte_meA highly cohesive, isolate-driven downloader and remuxer.

High-performance file downloads and zero-reencoding HLS to MKV remuxing for Dart/Flutter.

Get Started
View on GitHub

Isolate-Driven

Heavy tasks like AES-128 decryption and TS/MKV remuxing run seamlessly on background isolates, keeping the UI perfectly smooth.

Natively Remuxes HLS

Fully supports H.264/AAC extraction and multiplexing directly into standard Matroska (.mkv) containers—no FFmpeg needed!

Subtitle Injection

Interleave external SRT subtitle tracks effortlessly while downloading, embedding them as perfectly seekable S_TEXT tracks inside the MKV.
